# Generated civic data — do not edit by hand

This directory is vendored from the private `bettersanfernando-data` repo's
`exports/v0.1.0/` frontend-safe export. It is regenerated wholesale, never
hand-edited.

- Update: `pnpm data:sync` (requires a local `bettersanfernando-data` checkout)
- Validate: `pnpm data:validate` (public-repo only, no private checkout needed)
- Version pin: `civic-data.config.json`

Application code should import from `src/data/civic/` (the typed access
layer), not from the JSON files in this directory directly.
